78177.subject: Make ICOs Great Again
78177.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Gm, and happy Friday! BTC is taking a breather after gaining 10% over the past week. The next catalyst could come from Jackson Hole, where Kevin Warsh delivers his first keynote as Fed chair today.

Meanwhile, Washington may be preparing to reopen a door crypto thought had closed after 2017. New SEC proposals would give projects a path to sell tokens to US retail investors and eventually leave the investment contract regime. We look at whether compliant ICOs are about to return and which parts of the market stand to benefit.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC leads the benchmarks at 10.0% on the week against 1.8% for gold, 0.9% for the NASDAQ 100, and 0.8% for the S&P 500. Over the past month, BTC is up 25.7%, while gold has gained 15.6%.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/61c265f0-cdae-4957-8b85-f0d0f01b31e0/image.png?t=1787922530)
Caption: 

BTC ETF flows over the last week have totaled over $3B. This is the first time BTC has had eight consecutive days on net inflows since April 2026. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e889bec5-86ec-4797-be7e-98b40a55c06d/image.png?t=1787922530)
Caption: 

Similarly, ETH ETF flows over the last week were over $1.2B. Yesterday marked the 12th day of consecutive inflows, the first time in nearly one year (not since July 2025). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/bb00232b-44d1-47d6-8022-cc96ea451b59/image.png?t=1787922530)
Caption: 

Other notable mentions over the last week were SOL ($115M), XRP ($92M), and HYPE ($50M), highlighting the broadening demand beyond BTC and ETH.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0f3a1965-f021-46fe-bcca-b41e5204ee6f/image.png?t=1787922530)
Caption: 

Strong performance and sustained ETF inflows point to renewed institutional participation across the crypto market and add another tailwind to the recent turnaround. 

— [Marc Arjoon](https://x.com/marcarjoon)

———————————————————————————

78170.body:
Adrian's DeFi Insights 

Автор: Adrian Pape


Автор: Adrian Pape

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/you-positioned-yet-adrian-pape-2szre?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BOl7TzRTtQi2AP%2Fr%2FQao2Aw%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=39zmnXyIkbIso1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mtcxg4nn~vi-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mtcxg4nn-vi
  
Hey, it's Adrian! Are you positioned yet? The question is not theoretical anymore since last week. Bitcoin traded around $81.5k on Thursday, its highest since May, and sits at $79.4k as I write this. That is roughly 26% above the $62,9k low from August 17. Two camps are arguing about what all of this means, and both have good points. The four-year cycle loyalists point out that Bitcoin didn’t bottom inside the window it used in the last three cycles, which typically ran twelve months or longer. Price is still below the 50-week moving average at $81k, which is exactly where Tuesday’s high got rejected, so the technical structure stays bearish. The drawdown was shallow for a bear market, and they see weakness in equities still to come. The other camp counts differently. The 200-day moving average got sliced through and held. Price sits a long way above the 20-week moving average, which last week’s candle defended. Spot volume is up 150%. ETFs are buying billions of dollars of Bitcoin again, a marginal buyer that did not exist in previous cycles. And the short squeeze was historically large, which tells you how offside positioning had become. Here is where I land. I still think we could get a strong pullback into Q4 or the start of Q1 2027 to set a final higher low. But I can’t look past the weight of data pointing at a trend shift, and I’ve stopped arguing that the cycle bottom is ahead of us. Which is why I’m not asking the question from the sidelines. I’ve been building into this over the past several months and I’m now around 60% deployed: I documented these entries on X and Telegram: the June 4 entry into BTC: and the June 5 entries into BTC, ETH and SOL. But that's enough self praise, so let’s get into what the data says about this bull run and what it doesn’t say. ⚡ On today's Episode: 📈 Market Update – Bitcoin is up about 26% from its August 17 low after the Treasury said it will at least double its long-end buybacks from September 9 and Trump hinted the US government may buy Bitcoin. CryptoQuant’s Bull Score went from 30 to 80 in a week, 8 of its 10 metrics now bullish, the strongest reading since October 6, 2025 with Bitcoin at $124,000.
